name: EDEN FINAL
source:
Glen's capture puts an end to the war, and "Caucus" returns the the Earth's orbit. However, aliens sitting in Glen's body manage to separate from the body and infiltrate the ship. Ship's crew forces Glen to collaborate to find and eliminate the aliens on the ship.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
格伦被捕后，战争宣告结束，“Caucus”也返回地球轨道。然而寄生在格伦体内的外星生物设法脱离身体，潜入飞船。船员迫使格伦合作，寻找并消灭藏在船上的外星生物。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
